reports.title: AMSC Reports Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results and Business Outlook

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: For the third quarter ending December 31, 2026, AMSC expects that its revenues will exceed $80.0 million. The Company’s net income for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 is expected to exceed breakeven, or $0.00 per share. The Company's net income guidance assumes no changes in fair value of contingent consideration. The Company's non-GAAP net income (as defined below) is expected to exceed $7.0 million, or $0.15 per share. The Company's net income and non-GAAP net income guidance assumes estimated income tax expense of $0.5 million for the third quarter ending December 31, 2026.
